title: Quantum Mind: quantum robotics (computing, sensing and cognition) with classical baselines
description: Python library for the three threads of quantum robotics: quantum computing for robot algorithms (robot QUBOs, classical baselines, a Qiskit QAOA adapter), quantum sensing for robots (quantum-limited sensor models and Kalman fusion) and quantum-probability cognition (the COBRA belief filter and quantum-like human models), each tested against its classical baseline, with a 3D Bloch-sphere viewer.
